rdfs:label: differentFrom
rdfs:comment: Asserts that two OWL individuals are *not* the same — explicit negation, useful in worlds where the open-world assumption would otherwise leave identity ambiguous.
notes: Symmetric — `A differentFrom B` implies `B differentFrom A`. Distinct from `owl:disjointWith` (which separates *classes*); `differentFrom` separates *individuals*. Necessary because RDF doesn't assume Unique Name Assumption: without `differentFrom`, two distinctly-named resources might still be merged by reasoners.

examples.title: Two people explicitly marked as different
